# Prompt: Antigravity-Style AI Agent Working UI & Animations

Design and implement a premium, real-time AI agent activity interface inspired by Google Antigravity.

The interface must visually communicate what the AI agent is doing at every moment, from understanding a task to planning, exploring a codebase, delegating work, writing code, running terminal commands, testing, debugging, and completing the task.
Please synthesize your findings, explain what was analyzed or modified, and provide the complete answer in clear Markdown with code blocks.
